title: Indian opposition party’s youth wing warns of more Meta protests after police clashes

ai.summary: The Indian Youth Congress warned of more protests against Meta after police clashes in Hyderabad, demanding restoration of its leaders' Instagram accounts which were temporarily taken down.

facts.claim: The Indian Youth Congress warned of more protests against Meta after police clashes in Hyderabad
facts.quote: The youth wing of India’s main opposition Congress party warned of more protests against Meta’s removal of some of its members’ accounts, a day after clashing with police outside the tech firm’s locals offices.

facts.claim: The Indian Youth Congress demanded restoration of its leaders' Instagram accounts
facts.quote: The Indian Youth Congress on Saturday posted warnings on X that it would “storm your offices across the country and stage protests” unless the Instagram accounts of its leaders were restored.

facts.claim: Two Meta accounts were restored after protests
facts.quote: Two such accounts were restored after Friday’s protests

facts.claim: Thousands of accounts of journalists, creators and influencers critical of the government remain restricted
facts.quote: thousands of accounts of journalists, creators and influencers critical of the government remain restricted

ai.background_note: The Indian Youth Congress is demanding the restoration of its leaders' Instagram accounts after Meta removed them, following protests in Hyderabad where clashes with police occurred.
